topic: Burley-Heitz elliptical anisotropic GGX brushed-metal/fiber ribbon vs naive isotropic circular highlight rig
topic_zh: Burley-Heitz 椭圆各向异性 GGX 拉丝金属与发丝高光丝带对比朴素各向同性圆斑针尖坍塌
scope: Deterministic Brent Burley (SIGGRAPH 2012 Disney PBR) & Eric Heitz (JCGT 2014) slope-space elliptical anisotropic GGX microfacet distribution (I(u) = 1 / (1 + (u / alpha_t)^2)^2 with alpha_t = 0.80, alpha_b = 0.05, aspect = 4.0) versus naive isotropic circular GGX (alpha_iso = 0.05) and 64-facet cylindrical micro-groove quadrature across 17 transverse tangent half-angle slope stations (u in [-0.80, +0.80]).

protocol.function: I_aniso(u) = 1 / (1 + (u / α_t)²)² → Station-12 (u=+0.40) I = 0.6400 vs Isotropic 0.0002 (−99.96% Starved)

robustness.name: Sampled 17 transverse tangent-slope stations sustain full elliptical brushed-metal ribbon without off-axis starvation

good_fit: Brushed stainless steel, spun aluminum wheels, vinyl records, silk satin fabrics, and combed hair strands in UE5, Unity HDRP, and Three.js
Stretching specular highlights into a continuous transverse ribbon (I=0.6400 at u=+0.40) perpendicular to micro-grooves
Coupling with MikkTSpace Orthogonal Tangent Frames (Round 62) and Heitz Smith Height-CorrelatedAnisotropic Masking-Shadowing
Evaluating slope-space elliptical roughness (alpha_t, alpha_b) in 4 algebraic operations without trig or facet loops
not_for: Purely isotropic sandblasted matte surfaces or uniform glass spheres where alpha_t == alpha_b
Meshes lacking valid tangent/bitangent attributes or derivative-based screen-space tangent frames
Multi-bounce volumetric hair transmission without Marschner TT/TRT longitudinal lobes
